metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based streams of the staffing lifecycle Attract -> Sell -> Place -> Onboard -> Schedule -> Record hours -> Pay -> Bill -> Steer, plus VMS procurement, managed services and multi-country harmonisation.
